entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received last month. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with your order number? And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The order number is VF886-01. And no, there's no fault. It's really just a matter of preference. The color just doesn't quite match my bike the way I thought it would from the website pictures. The box is unopened, it's exactly as it arrived.

I understand completely. We want you to love the gear you're in, especially when it comes to your safety. Let me just pull up that order, VF886-01... Okay, I see it here. The VeloFit Aero-Tech helmet. It looks like it was delivered 27 days ago.

Not a problem at all. For a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label.

Oh, that's great. Thank you. Since I'll be ordering a replacement, and going through the hassle of sending this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I'll be buying the same helmet, just in a different color.

I appreciate you asking, and I understand why you would. Unfortunately, our system doesn't allow me to generate goodwill credits or discount codes for preference-based returns. However, I can assure you the return process is very simple. Once we receive the original item, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Alright, I thought it was worth a shot. A full refund is what I was hoping for, so that works perfectly. Please send over that label.

Of course. The email with the shipping label is on its way to your inbox now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any carrier location. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
